topics.name: Content Revision Identity
topics.purpose: Define exact immutable content/data revision evidence separately from stable logical resource identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each accepted content revision has explicit revision identity/hash/version evidence.
semantics.resource_rule: Revision belongs to exact logical resource.
semantics.parent_rule: Predecessor/base revision refs are explicit where applicable.
semantics.immutability_rule: Accepted revision content is immutable; correction creates new revision.
semantics.hash_rule: Content hash may identify bytes but stable resource identity remains separate.
semantics.ordering_rule: Revision ancestry/sequence is explicit rather than mtime-based.
semantics.authority_rule: Newer revision has no automatic authority/preference.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: hash used as stable resource id universally
